notice: Every complaint, name, phone number, handle and transaction below is invented for this demo. Any resemblance to real persons or cases is coincidental.

cases.title: Fake SBI KYC page harvested netbanking credentials
cases.narrative: Complainant received an SMS claiming her SBI account would be blocked without KYC verification. She clicked the link http://sbi-kyc-verify.top/login and entered her netbanking credentials, card details and CVV. Within an hour, three transactions totalling 84,500 INR were debited to UPI handle fastpay247@ybl. The link was shared from phone +91 9830011223.

timeline.event: Complaint filed at cybercell portal; acknowledgement issued.
Auto-triage routed the complaint to Phishing with high confidence (keywords: kyc, link, card details, otp).
URL analyser scored sbi-kyc-verify.top 90/100: brand impersonation, risky TLD, plain HTTP on a login page.
Bank notified to freeze the beneficiary UPI handle; takedown request drafted for the registrar.
Case escalated to district cybercrime unit for transaction tracing.

cases.title: UPI collect-request scam via fake courier refund
cases.narrative: Caller posed as a courier executive and said a 450 INR refund required approving a collect request on PhonePe. Complainant scanned the QR code and approved; 24,999 INR was debited instead. The collect request came from refund-desk@okhdfcbank. Caller number +91 9007012345.

timeline.event: Complaint filed with transaction reference screenshots attached.
Auto-triage routed to UPI / Payment Fraud (keywords: upi, qr code, refund, collect request, debited).
Beneficiary VPA flagged to the payment aggregator for hold and KYC review.

cases.title: Telegram 'trading tips' group ran a fake investment platform
cases.narrative: Complainant joined a Telegram group promising 30% weekly returns on USDT trading. He invested 3.2 lakh INR across four transfers to a platform at https://royal-fx-gain.xyz/app. Withdrawal is now blocked unless he pays a 15% 'tax'. Group admin used handle @profitguru_official.

timeline.event: Complaint filed; platform URL and wallet addresses recorded.
Auto-triage routed to Investment & Trading Scam (keywords: trading, usdt, returns, telegram group, withdrawal blocked).
URL analyser: royal-fx-gain.xyz scored 65/100; domain registered weeks ago, no valid TLS history noted by analyst.
Escalated to state CID crypto tracing cell; exchange freeze request initiated.

cases.title: Morphed photos used for extortion over WhatsApp
cases.narrative: Unknown sender messaged the complainant on WhatsApp with morphed photos and demanded 50,000 INR, threatening to circulate them. The demand included a UPI handle payfast.don@okicici and a threat to message her workplace.

timeline.event: Complaint filed; evidence screenshots preserved with hashes by the desk officer.
Auto-triage routed to Online Harassment (keywords: morphed, blackmail, threatening, demanding money).
Preservation request sent to the messaging platform; UPI beneficiary traced to a payment aggregator account.

cases.title: Loan taken using victim's Aadhaar and PAN photocopies
cases.narrative: Complainant discovered a 60,000 INR consumer loan opened in his name after sharing Aadhaar and PAN photocopies with a 'loan agent' met through a Facebook group. A SIM card registered to his identity is active on a number he does not recognise.

timeline.event: Complaint filed with credit report extract showing the unknown loan.
Auto-triage routed to Identity Misuse (keywords: aadhaar, pan card, sim card, loan in my name).

cases.title: Screen-sharing app used to empty a senior citizen's account
cases.narrative: Caller claiming to be from the bank's fraud desk asked the complainant to install a screen-sharing app to 'reverse a wrong transaction'. While the screen was shared, the caller read OTPs aloud and made five transactions totalling 1.9 lakh INR.

timeline.event: Complaint filed; device handed over for forensic imaging.
Auto-triage routed to Ransomware & Malware (keywords: screen sharing, remote access, otp).
Device image queued for malware analysis; bank reversal request logged.

cases.title: Fake customs call demanded fees to release a 'prize parcel'
cases.narrative: Complainant was told she had won a UK lottery parcel held at customs and must pay 18,500 INR in clearance fees to customs.release@paytm. She paid once, then refused a second demand and reported.

timeline.event: Complaint filed; single payment receipt attached.
Auto-triage routed to Lottery & Prize Scam (keywords: lottery, prize, customs, parcel, fees to claim).
Beneficiary account debited-frozen by bank; amount recovered in full.
Case closed after refund; complainant counselled on advance-fee fraud.

cases.title: Job portal applicants redirected to a fee-collecting fake portal
cases.narrative: After applying on a job site, complainant was emailed a 'verification' link, http://naukri-verify-secure.info/account, asking for a 999 INR registration fee and full card details. Sender email hr-verification@naukri-verify-secure.info.

timeline.event: Complaint filed with email headers attached.
Auto-triage routed to Phishing (keywords: link, card details, verification).

cases.title: QR stickers replaced at a market stall; daily takings diverted
cases.narrative: A vegetable vendor found that customers' UPI payments for two days went to an unknown handle marketpay.official@okaxis after someone pasted a replacement QR sticker over hers. Estimated loss 32,000 INR. CCTV footage is being collected.

timeline.event: Complaint filed at local police station and forwarded to cybercell.
Auto-triage routed to UPI / Payment Fraud (keywords: upi, qr code, payments).
Aggregator asked to freeze marketpay.official@okaxis and provide KYC of the holder.
Escalated: same handle appears in two more market complaints, indicating a pattern.

cases.title: Ransom note after boutique's billing PC was encrypted
cases.narrative: The complainant's shop billing computer was locked overnight with a ransom note demanding 0.05 BTC to decrypt files. A remote access tool had been installed weeks earlier via a fake 'GST update' email attachment.

timeline.event: Complaint filed; ransom note photo and wallet address recorded.
Auto-triage routed to Ransomware & Malware (keywords: ransomware, encrypted, decrypt, remote access).
Disk image acquired; advised against payment; backup restore in progress.
